title: Behavior Graphs: Unsupervised Graph Structures for Interpreting Robot Deployment Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.00405v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Data flywheels promise continuous improvement via insights from deployment data. Understanding how the deployed model succeeds and fails can steer subsequent data collection towards patching failures and reinforcing successes. However, robot deployments create large volumes of high-dimensional rollout data, which is challenging to understand and confidently ground data collection decisions in. To make deployment data easier to analyze and act on, we propose behavior graphs, which compress policy rollouts into a single interpretable, directed graph. We construct the graphs by learning to identify similar behavior modes across rollouts, connecting the behaviors temporally, and finally linking them to outcomes. In a user study on three real-world tasks, where participants analyzed rollouts to choose a data collection strategy, 16 of 18 preferred behavior graphs to rollout videos, reaching comparable conclusions with 40.3% lower perceived

translated_title: 行为图：用于解释机器人部署数据的无监督图结构
translated_abstract: 数据飞轮承诺通过从部署数据中获得的洞察实现持续改进。理解部署后的模型如何成功与失败，可以引导后续的数据收集，从而修补失败并强化成功。然而，机器人部署会产生大量高维的rollout数据，这些数据难以理解，也难以据此做出有把握的数据收集决策。为了让部署数据更易于分析和采取行动，我们提出了行为图，它将策略rollout压缩成一张单一的、可解释的有向图。我们通过学习识别不同rollout之间相似的行为模式、在时间维度上连接这些行为，并最终将它们与结果关联起来来构建该图。在一项针对三个真实世界任务的用户研究中，参与者通过分析rollout来选择数据收集策略，18名参与者中有16名更偏好行为图而非rollout视频，且在感知负荷降低40.3%的情况下得出了相当的结论。
tldr: 该论文提出“行为图”这一无监督方法，将机器人策略rollout数据压缩为一张单一、可解释的有向图，通过识别相似行为模式、按时序连接并与结果关联，显著降低了部署数据的分析难度，使研究者能更高效地指导数据收集决策。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes behavior graphs, an unsupervised approach that compresses robot policy rollout data into a single interpretable directed graph by identifying similar behavior modes, connecting them temporally, and linking them to outcomes, making deployment data easier to analyze and act upon for guiding data collection decisions.
